findings.suggested_fix: Split compound criteria, replace subjective terms with observable outcomes, and state how each is verified.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Add an explicit bootstrap step: first raise FIELD_READY_BUDGET_S to a generous interim ceiling, run the harness to GREEN so the new success-side readiness line emits the actual field-registration elapsed, THEN record that number as MEASURED_FIELD_REGISTRATION_S and set the final budget to >= 2x it.
evidence: Step 2: 'recorded verbatim from a live harness run's readiness line'
Step 2: 'stage one of the same gate took 316s ... and 485s' — stage one, not the field-registration stage
Evidence: run 30975323866 = '62 ERRORS ... still absent after 61 poll(s) over 600s' — stage 2 never completed, so no success-side elapsed exists
AC1: 'sized from MEASURED plugin-registration time on this image, with the measurement recorded'
findings.finding: The seed measurement AC1 requires (MEASURED_FIELD_REGISTRATION_S 'recorded verbatim from a live harness run's readiness line') cannot be obtained from any existing run: the failing run 30975323866 errored at the 600s budget before stage-2 field registration completed, and the cited 316s/485s are stage-ONE timings, not the Epic-field registration time the budget must cover. The plan does not describe an interim step to raise the budget high enough for one run to SUCCEED and emit the success-side readiness line the measurement is read from.
scenarios: Executor tries to set MEASURED_FIELD_REGISTRATION_S but finds no green run has ever emitted the field-registration elapsed line
findings.suggested_fix: Insert a step before step 2: dispatch the harness with a temporarily large JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT override to capture the real registration elapsed from the success readiness line, record the run id, then size the committed budget from it.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] specify how the FIRST registration-time measurement is obtained before a green budget exists — e.g. a one-off dispatch with `JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT` set generously high purely to harvest the success readiness line — so step 2's measurement does not depend on step 5's already-green run
evidence: Step 2: 'Add MEASURED_FIELD_REGISTRATION_S, recorded verbatim from a live harness run's readiness line, and set FIELD_READY_BUDGET_S to >= 2x it.'
Enabling defect: 'the wait recorded nothing on SUCCESS, so no green run ever produced the number a budget could be sized from — only expiries, which say "too small" and not "how small".'

Code: harness `_field_ready_timeout()` reads `JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT` env override before falling back to `FIELD_READY_BUDGET_S` (conftest.py:152-155) — the override is the natural lever for a one-off high-budget measurement dispatch.
findings.finding: The budget is to be sized from a live green readiness line, but the plan's own enabling-defect statement says no green field-readiness run has ever existed — producing a bootstrap circularity the plan does not resolve: to emit a SUCCESS measurement the run must already have a budget exceeding real registration time.
findings.location: Fix plan step 2 ('Size the budget from the measurement') and step 5 ('Verify live'); enabling-defect sentence 'no green run ever produced the number'
scenarios: The first measurement dispatch still uses the 600s budget (or any budget < real registration time) and expires again, yielding an expiry line, not the success measurement step 2 needs.
findings.suggested_fix: State that the initial measurement run overrides `JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT` to a deliberately large value (well above suspected registration time), captures the success readiness line's elapsed, and only then sets `MEASURED_FIELD_REGISTRATION_S` and `FIELD_READY_BUDGET_S >= 2x` for the committed default.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] correct the 2x justification to state the 316s/485s figures are stage-one (serverInfo) durations used only as a runner-variance proxy, or supply an observed stage-two field-registration spread, so the multiplier is grounded in the quantity actually being sized
evidence: Evidence section: run 30964805133 'was 62 passed, 1 xfailed, 0 failed' and is the run 'before 1406 landed' — i.e. the serverInfo gate, no field wait.

conftest.py stage split: stage 1 polls `/rest/api/2/serverInfo` (wait_for_jira_dc_ready lines 193-207), stage 2 is `await_required_fields` on `/rest/api/2/field` (lines 209-218) — distinct budgets `JIRA_DC_READY_TIMEOUT` vs `JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT`.
The quantity being sized in step 2 is FIELD_READY_BUDGET_S (stage two).
findings.finding: The '>= 2x' factor is justified by 316s/485s figures attributed to 'stage one of the same gate', but run 30964805133 predates 1406 and had no field-registration (stage-two) wait at all, so those numbers are serverInfo (stage-one) poll durations — the multiplier for the stage-two field-registration budget is derived from a different stage than the one being sized.
findings.location: Fix plan step 2, sentence 'The 2x is itself measured: stage one of the same gate took 316s on run 30964805133 and 485s on run 30975323866'
scenarios: A reviewer or future maintainer treats 316s/485s as field-registration times and mis-sizes the budget, or the 1.53x spread understates stage-two variance which may differ from serverInfo-boot variance.
